maintenance_led.reason: Sells cannabis consumables (wholesale brands and Sunnyside dispensary retail), used up in normal use, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers and patients buying cannabis at Sunnyside dispensaries and from wholesale to other retailers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its brands, wholesale and Sunnyside retail; past multi-state deals were notable but it isn't a regular roll-up now.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers and wholesale retail buyers can switch cannabis brands or dispensaries easily; products are consumable and not qualified into other products.
